news.title: A Mile Wide, an Inch Deep: The State of Civic Learning in U.S. School Districts
news.summary_en: This brief is the first in a three-part series from the American School District Panel, a research partnership between RAND and CRPE that surveys hundreds of school district leaders.

news.title: Pooling Europe's compute: The promise of distributed training for European frontier AI
news.summary_en: Frontier AI training has needed compute at one site, hard in Europe given power, chip and political limits. RAND Europe finds distributed training eases the power and political constraints and pools Europe's scattered chips, but adds no new chips.

news.title: Strategic Autonomy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
news.summary_en: This essay argues that the rapid advance of AI will frustrate ambitions for strategic autonomy.

news.title: AI as Strategist: Four Hypotheses on the Nature of Agentic Strategy
news.summary_en: In this chapter, the author considers a radical future, a world in which nations pursue relative advantage, for national security, and for other national objectives guided by AI models that are mostly playing these strategy games against other models.

news.title: Bilateral AI Partnerships Alone Won't Secure Australia. Here’s a Multilateral Alternative
news.summary_en: Australia's answer to regional AI collaboration lies in federated learning, an AI model that allows cross-border collaboration on transnational security issues whilst preserving data sovereignty.

news.title: Technical Documentation for the Thirteenth American School District Panel Survey
news.summary_en: This report provides technical information about the spring 2026 survey of the American School District Panel. The authors describe the survey administration and weighting processes they used to produce nationally representative estimates.

news.title: Artificial Intelligence and the Risk of Strategic Cyberattack
news.summary_en: The author argues that agentic artificial intelligence will alleviate the key constraints on cyber operations and may unlock strategic potential in cyber weapons that has, until now, remained largely theoretical.

news.title: Shrinking Budgets, Fewer Students: How District Leaders are Navigating a New Landscape of Reduced Resources and Competitive Pressures
news.summary_en: This report presents findings from the spring 2026 American School District Panel survey. Budget shortfalls and declining enrollment have risen to the top of district leaders’ concerns, worsening other challenges that districts are facing.
